venira.speed_profile: fast; triggers cache invalidation for the new directory.
venira.use_when: you need an empty directory. For a file use write_file, which also creates parent folders.

description:
Create a directory; missing parents are created unless create_dirs=false.
Use when: you need an empty directory. For a file use write_file, which also creates parent folders.
Avoid when: you edit existing content (edit_file).
Output: directory_created {relative_path, created, parents_created}.

create_dirs.description: true (default) creates missing parent directories; false fails when a parent is missing.

relative_path.description: Workspace-relative ('.' = root); absolute/.. outside it rejected.

name: create
title: Create directory
